generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.
Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025 % of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contracthas been issued to bidder

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The Departments shall not be responsible for non accessibility of Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.
The bidder shall quote rates excluding GST only.

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending Bidder shall have successfully carried out similar work (i.e., Overhauling/ testing/commissioning of 66kv and above switchyard equipment) in any Central or State Govt. or PSUs or any reputed private organizations. In this regard, the intending bidder shall have successfully carried out the said work as Prime Contractor in a single Work done of value not less than Rs0.95Lakhs in Central or State Govt. or PSUs or any reputed private organizations in last preceding five financial years (Financial Year 2021-22 to 2025-26) and shall furnish copy of the related Work order and Work done certificate issued by the competent authority as documentary evidence. Cost of completed works of previous years will be given 10 percent of simple weightage per year to bring them to current year price level.
The intending bidder shall have valid Super Grade Electrical Contractor License issued by the Electrical Inspectorate/competent authority.

Financial Turnover of previous years will be given 10 percent of simple weightage per year to bring them to current year price level.
